value.rationale: A complete sharp coefficient/intercept condition identifies an open, structurally motivated coexistence region despite monotonically worsening realized latency in each scenario; the exact phase diagram reveals two stable pure choices, saddle-node loss of the upper mixed equilibrium, and materially different mean social costs. These constitute a reproducible counterexample and model-design benchmark, not a routine parameter substitution or empirical claim.
